name: CharacterCount
intro: Use Root with Input, visible Status, and SrStatus. Use Field.Label inside an enclosing Field.Root to label the input.

parts.name: Root
parts.description: Owns the input value and character limit.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Sets the character limit. Input permits extra characters and becomes invalid when the count exceeds it.

props.name: errorText
props.description: Native validity message when over the limit. Defaults to "The content is too long."

props.name: statusLabel
props.description: Text in the initial count message. Defaults to "characters allowed".

props.name: ids
props.type: { root?: string; control?: string; input?: string; description?: string; status?: string; srStatus?: string }
props.description: Overrides generated part IDs. Use Root IDs when a label or external control needs a stable input or trigger target.

parts.name: Input
parts.description: Receives text and exposes over-limit state.

parts.name: SrStatus
parts.description: Renders a div containing the initial limit description and a visually hidden span that announces debounced count changes.
